response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack/web software developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang experience, but his background is almost entirely in web platforms, product engineering, and developer tooling. The role requires deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, AI accelerator performance analysis, and hardware-software co-design — areas essentially absent from this resume. Beyond some low-latency backend work and brief C/C++ exposure at National Instruments, there is no evidence of GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture work, deep-learning workload optimization, or hardware performance modeling required for a principal-level architect position.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience, meeting the years-of-experience bar
Some systems-level exposure: low-latency DLang services, async I/O, and C/C++ IDE components
Recent hands-on AI-adjacent work with agent infrastructure and MCP tooling
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, or hardware design experience
No background in GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD, or DNN training/inference optimization
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, not principal-level performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or DNN workload optimization background
Solid general software engineering and some low-latency systems work
